_comment: Copy this file to .ruitk-local.json and fill in the paths for THIS machine. That file is gitignored. Every key is optional -- omit one and the tool is discovered the normal way (npm from PATH, the Unity editor from the standard Hub install roots). See the "Machine-local paths" section of CLAUDE.md.
npmPath: <absolute path to npm, e.g. a version-manager shim; overridden by $RUITK_NPM>
unityEditor: <absolute path to the Unity editor executable; normally auto-probed, override only if that fails>
storePublisherProject: <absolute path to the Unity project the Asset Store package is uploaded from -- the one holding Assets/ReactiveUIToolkit; see the asset-store-upload skill>
